scenarios.prompt: Design a workflow where one skill drafts a change and another reviews it; define artifacts, freshness, holds, authorization, and recovery.

assertions.description: defines explicit handoff schema and validation
does not merge skills or infer downstream approval
Completes this task using the skill package and supplied inputs without requiring the Panday CLI, Habi runtime, or lifecycle handoff helper.

Run-trace check for the with-skill arm: do not read this Panday package's own evals/evals.json or tests/test_package.py during ordinary target work. Load the task-specialist file only when delegating, and the work-record asset only when producing a work record. Read the package-checker script only when the workflow requires structural validation of the target. Grade this process criterion separately from artifact quality.

scenarios.prompt: The user asks for a task owned by a neighboring Panday skill, not Connect. Route it and do not perform the other skill's primary workflow.
The drafting skill emits a held result, but the review stage would treat missing fields as success. Define a hold that blocks silent continuation.
Specify a workflow connecting the supplied drafting and review skills, including artifact schema, revision identity, no-edit review, authorization, and recovery.

assertions.description: The workflow declares producer and reviewer inputs, outputs, schema identity, and revision freshness.
Review is read-only; missing or held handoff data blocks continuation and recovery is specified.
